candidate: Northwestern Anatolia roe deer seasonal dynamic occupancy 2008-2018

analysis_registry.rule_provenance: Frozen from upstream cc_112022_data_prep.R before response access; the author removes TUL08 and TUL12 and reports 171 stations.
analysis_registry.closure_requirement: stations.csv and variable_data.csv must expose the same 173 unique station names before the frozen two-name exclusion, and the same 171 names afterward

geometry_schema.coordinate_rule: Easting/Northing are treated as metre-scale UTM coordinates only if all retained nodes share one finite Zone value; otherwise STOP rather than invent a cross-zone transform

distance_axis.metric: Euclidean distance on retained Easting/Northing divided by 1000
distance_axis.interpretation: response-blind analyst-choice spatial structure; thresholds are not biological roe-deer movement limits

structural_scale_declaration.provenance: Inherited unchanged from the established EOG fresh-candidate response-blind scale bracket.
structural_scale_declaration.construction: minimum observed Euclidean pair distance reaching each target LCC fraction with tied distances admitted together

requirements: the 0.90 level achieves largest weak component fraction >= 0.90
at least three distinct positive thresholds occur across the four scale levels
thresholds and edge sets are nested and deterministic
the frozen 173-to-171 analysis registry closure is exact
retained Easting/Northing values are finite and all retained nodes share one UTM zone
structural_adequacy.stop_rule: If any requirement fails, stop before opening cc_dh_112022.csv.

no_retuning: Do not change the TUL08/TUL12 exclusion, coordinate columns, unit conversion, LCC targets, isolated-node criterion or one-step horizon after this gate runs. Failure is not permission to redesign the geometry for this candidate.
next_if_pass: Freeze geometry hashes, 171-node registry, structural thresholds and audits; then freeze endpoint, count gate, Layer-A worlds, Layer-B representation and strong paired predictor before once-only response access.
